tasks.label: 🚀 Docker: Start Dev (All)
tasks.command: cd client && npm install --legacy-peer-deps; cd ../server && npm install; cd .. && docker compose --profile dev up --build

windows.command: cd client; npm install --legacy-peer-deps; cd ../server; npm install; cd ..; docker compose --profile dev up --build

tasks.label: 💻 Docker: Start Client Only
tasks.command: cd client && npm install --legacy-peer-deps; cd .. && docker compose --profile dev-client up --build

windows.command: cd client; npm install --legacy-peer-deps; cd ..; docker compose --profile dev-client up --build

tasks.label: ⚡ Docker: Start Server Only
tasks.command: cd server && npm install; cd .. && docker compose --profile dev-server up --build

windows.command: cd server; npm install; cd ..; docker compose --profile dev-server up --build

tasks.label: 🧼 Docker: Safe Clean Frontend Cache (Keep Mongo Data)
tasks.command: docker compose --profile dev down -v && sudo chown -R $(id -u):$(id -g) . && rm -rf client/node_modules server/node_modules

tasks.label: 💥 RISK: Wipe All Docker Containers & Images
tasks.command: docker compose down --rmi all --volumes --remove-orphans && docker system prune -a --volumes -f
